source.title: 3.4.1: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories
source.applicability: Baseline configurations including system components, version management, and update/patch information for workstations and endpoint inventory management

passages.text: Baseline configurations include information about system components (e.g., standard software packages installed on workstations, notebook computers, servers, network components, or mobile devices; current version numbers and update and patch information
